description: Source code for MCUboot integration in Zephyr OS, handling image headers, swap operations, upgrade requests, and flash area management.

methods.name: boot_read_v1_header
methods.description: Reads and validates the v1 image header from flash area.

methods.name: boot_read_bank_header
methods.description: Reads the image header for a specified flash area.

methods.name: mcuboot_swap_type_multi
methods.description: Returns the swap type for multi-image.

methods.name: boot_request_upgrade
methods.description: Requests an upgrade by setting the image as pending.

methods.name: boot_is_img_confirmed
methods.description: Checks if the current image is confirmed.

methods.name: boot_write_img_confirmed
methods.description: Marks the current image as confirmed.

methods.name: boot_write_img_confirmed_multi
methods.description: Marks a specific image as confirmed in multi-image setup.

methods.name: boot_get_trailer_status_offset
methods.description: Calculates the offset for trailer status in flash area.

methods.name: boot_get_area_trailer_status_offset
methods.description: Calculates trailer status offset for a specific flash area.
